source_conflicts.scope: Reported range of country-specific preference for the EQ-5D-Y-5L

statements.statement: The abstract states that 68–88% of participants per country preferred the 5L version.
The detailed results report Germany 88%, Spain 68%, and Sweden 66%, giving a range of 66–88%.
source: Full article: Results, Phase 2, preference paragraph
Full article: Results, Phase 2, preference paragraph

source_conflicts.scope: Number of respondents who completed both questionnaires in the main survey

statements.statement: The abstract states that 1056 respondents completed EQ-5D-5L and WHOQOL-BREF.
The results state that 10 of the 1056 EQ-5D-5L respondents did not complete WHOQOL-BREF, leaving 1046 for WHOQOL-BREF norms analysis.
source: Full article, Results > WHOQOL-BREF population norm, first paragraph
Full article, Results > WHOQOL-BREF population norm, first paragraph

source_conflicts.scope: Administration mode of the Indonesian FACIT-COST

statements.statement: The abstract reports that the official Indonesian FACIT-COST (v2) was administered to patients by interviewers.
The full Methods report that patients completed the paper-and-pencil questionnaire themselves, with research assistants available to provide explanations when needed.

source_conflicts.scope: Number of included studies evaluating EQ-5D-5L

statements.statement: The abstract reports that EQ-5D-5L was evaluated in seven studies.
The main Results section reports that EQ-5D-5L was tested in eight studies and cites eight included studies.
source: Full article, Results > Study Characteristics, first paragraph
Full article, Results > Study Characteristics, first paragraph

source_conflicts.scope: Significance of the difference between elicited and confirmed utilities by health state

statements.statement: The Results prose states that confirmed utilities were significantly lower for all health states except state 24443, for which p = 0.39.
source: Full article, Results, Elicited, confirmed and corrected cTTO utilities, first paragraph

statements.statement: Table 4 shows no significance marker for state 22434 and shows a significance marker for state 24443 in the elicited-versus-confirmed comparison.

Full article, Results, Elicited, confirmed and corrected cTTO utilities, first paragraph

source_conflicts.scope: Labels of confirmed-minus-corrected difference rows in Table 4

statements.statement: For state 55555, Table 4 reports confirmed utility −0.72, constant-alternative corrected utility −0.94, and maximum-BTD corrected utility −3.41.
source: Full article, Results, Table 4, utility rows

statements.statement: For state 55555, the difference row labeled constant alternative reports 2.69, while the row labeled maximum BTD reports 0.22; these labels conflict with the reported utility means.

source_conflicts.scope: Inclusion of self-rated health as an independent variable in the regression analysis

statements.statement: The abstract states that the independent variables included self-rated health.
The reported regression specification and Table 2 do not list self-rated health among the examined independent variables.
source: Full article, Results > Determinants of Time Trade-Off Scores of Health States, Table 2

Full article, Results, Section 3.2 and Figure 2

source_conflicts.scope: Rates of respondents reporting any problems on the pain/discomfort and anxiety/depression dimensions

statements.statement: The Abstract reports that pain/discomfort and anxiety/depression had problem rates of 43% and 39%, respectively.
Table 5 reports level-1 rates of 50% for pain/discomfort and 55% for anxiety/depression, which implies approximately 50% and 45%, respectively, at levels 2–5.
The Abstract and Discussion state that data collection ran through May 2023.
